# klmhonos

> Official website of klmhonos, the rap artist also known as Kalovel.

klmhonos is a rapper with roughly 56,000 monthly Spotify listeners. His biggest
track, "this love (remix)", has over 4 million streams. He started releasing
music in 2024 and his catalog spans two albums, one EP, and 15+ singles.

## Discography
- Albums: #Ghoultape (2025), Wasted (2025)
- EP: Bad Omen (2024)
- Singles include: the silhouette, howdidimakeumine, the lobotomy (remix),
  too gone, i dont feel the same (2026); Lokked In, Rokkstar Life,
  break shi (havinamo) (2025); this love (remix), 5orrow, honos, troopz,
  #krookmove (2024)
- Top tracks: this love (remix), August 10 (never learn), 5orrow,
  Sit n pray (Under your spell), troopz
